text:
Leo (AE): Heads-up — FalconHealth asked for a firm delivery date for Private deploy + KMS + audit logs, they want Q3 prod by their go‑live. Can we commit?
Maya (PM): Short answer: not without scope tradeoffs. Want to map asks to must-have vs nice-to-have before promising.
Leo (AE): They listed: 1) Private deployment (VPC) 2) Customer-managed KMS 3) 180‑day audit log retention + export 4) SLA 99.9% 5) Model pinning + rollback. Want a single date.
Sasha (eng): From infra side: VPC private control plane + model pinning we can do on Dedicated pattern we already have, but KMS integration and 180d retention need effort (KMS: ~3 weeks infra + 1 week security review; logs: ~2 weeks storage/retention + backup/exports). Calendar-wise that's ~6 weeks dev + review if prioritized.
Tom (solutions): Also note FalconHealth requires SOC2-like evidence for the KMS flow and a vendor KMS (they use CloudKMS). That adds compliance coordination (security + customer legal).
Maya (PM): Ok — propose we split into two milestones so we can give them a realistic go‑live:
• M1 (GA target): Private deploy (VPC), model pinning & rollback, basic observability, SLA baseline (best‑effort) — target date: 2024-09-20.
• M2 (post‑GA): Customer KMS + 180d retention export + formal SLA/attestations — target: 2024-11-01.
Leo (AE): FalconHealth will push back on split, they want everything by go‑live. Any chance to accelerate M2 if we push more people?
Sasha (eng): To accelerate KMS we'd need a short spike to validate integration pattern (1 week) then a focused 2‑engineer sprint for 2 weeks. We could compress to ~4 weeks instead of 6 if we reallocate. But that will bump other Q3 work and we need signoff from Eng Leads.
Jules (VP Product): Tradeoffs: accelerating M2 costs ~0.5 FTE across the quarter and increases risk to unrelated OKRs. Is Falcon willing to accept a revenue/contract commitment to prioritize? If yes, we can consider a fast track.
Leo (AE): They're open to a revenue commitment and a short implementation surcharge. I can negotiate commercial terms but need engineered timeline to promise.
Maya (PM): Action items:
• Leo: confirm commercial commitment by 2024-07-15.
• Sasha: estimate fast-track resource needs and blockers by 2024-07-10 (include security review ETA).
• Tom: prepare customer integration checklist + audit evidence needed by 2024-07-12.
• Maya: draft scope doc and acceptance criteria for M1/M2 by 2024-07-11.
Sasha (eng): Quick note on rollout policy: we'll do canary in a private subnet first, then staged rollout across their regions. Plan: canary (2 instances) -> 24h validation -> region ramp. We'll need a fallback plan to hosted model variants for traffic >X TPS.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: private-controlplane/stage -> prod at 2024-07-08T02:00Z (note: staging infra changes may affect timeline).
Tom (solutions): Integration checklist preview (short):
```
- VPC peering setup steps
- KMS key policy & rotation window
- Logging endpoint + export to S3/archival
- Compliance evidence artifacts (config diff + runbook)
```
Maya (PM): Acceptance criteria (M1):
- Private deploy configured in customer's VPC and validated in staging
- Models can be pinned and rolled back via Console/API
- Observability dashboard shows per‑route latency and token cost
- Basic SLA commitment documented (with schedule for upgrade)
Acceptance criteria (M2):
- Customer-managed KMS integrated end‑to‑end
- 180d log retention + export working and tested
- Formal SLA + attestation pack produced
Leo (AE): I'll loop in customer security and legal and push to get the commercial note by 7/15.
Jules (VP Product): If Leo gets commitment, I'll sign off on resource prioritization for fast track. Otherwise we stick to M1/M2 plan.
Maya (PM): Sounds good. Will post consolidated scope doc + timeline into the account folder and ping here when done.
Leo (AE): Thanks — will update FalconHealth and follow up in this thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Sasha (eng): tagging potential blocker: if CloudKMS audit needs dedicated HSM flow, that adds ~2 weeks. I'll call security now.
Tom (solutions): Also recommending we prepare a short runbook for their ops team — helps acceptance testing. I'll start a draft.
Maya (PM): Great. Next sync if we have a commercial yes — 2024-07-16 10:00am PT. If not, weekly check-ins until decision.
Leo (AE): noted.
